description: CwdChanged through the CLI (spec §8, k147): a move within the session's checkout – CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR the project, into a subdirectory – syncs nothing, though the project has no lock; a move from another directory into that subdirectory syncs the checkout's project scope at its git top level, not the subdirectory and not CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (the session's, here the empty cwd), and leaves the user scope's own install alone; the answer is the one line naming the checkout, no context. The same move again finds the lock matching the config: silent. Every run exits 0.
